shared_elements: a row of repeated rounded/curved forms (waves in A, repeated headdresses/vessels in B)
justification: A depicts a single schematic sailing vessel with mast, sail and hull riding over a band of stylised wave arcs, while B depicts a file of bearded human figures in profile, each raising a bowl or vessel; there is no shared motif beyond the trivial fact that both use repeated curved forms along a horizontal register. The manner of depiction also differs sharply: A is a pure thin-line outline drawing with no modelling, B is fully modelled relief with naturalistic anatomy and minutely rendered hair and drapery.
